nodes.label: Service-to-Service Auth (CRON_SECRET)
nodes.rationale: Callers with no human attached (Vercel Cron, release scripts) authenticate via Authorization: Bearer $CRON_SECRET instead of a live Clerk session; comparison uses timingSafeEqual rather than === to avoid timing attacks, and system-triggered broadcasts are attributed to release-bot@admobihq.com in the audit log to distinguish them from staff-sent announcements.

nodes.label: Public Route Rate Limiting (Upstash)
nodes.rationale: Fails open (unthrottled) when UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL/TOKEN are unset, so local dev and environments missing those vars keep working rather than erroring — a deliberate tradeoff that must be verified before relying on it in production.

nodes.label: Support Case Identity Token
nodes.rationale: Email alone is guessable, so a per-email identity token gates GET /v1/public/support; it is minted once per email and never reissued, because reissuing would silently invalidate whatever device already stored the original token — leaving a known gap for users who clear local storage before ever opening a case.
